description: This file defines a specialized class `AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu` within the `torch::inductor` namespace, which is responsible for running AI models on XPU devices. It includes constructor/destructor implementations, methods for running models with specific streams, and a factory function for creating instances of the runner.
